title: Your Profile
content: Your Profile is where you manage your personal details, raise and track support requests, and set your notification preferences — all in one place.

title: Open Profile
content: Click your profile card to open the profile page.

title: Basic Information
content: This section holds your core identity on the platform — name, email, role, and phone number. Keep it accurate so alerts and team communications always reach the right person.

title: Support Activity
content: All support tickets you've raised — bug reports, feature requests, and general queries — appear here. Track their status and add follow-up comments without leaving the platform.

title: Submit New Request
content: Click Submit New Request to open the support form, pre-filled with your name and email, so you can raise a ticket without re-entering your details.

title: Full Name
content: Your full name is pulled from your profile and locked — every ticket is automatically attributed to the correct person.

title: Work Email
content: Your registered email is pre-filled and read-only. The support team will reply to this address when they respond to your ticket.

title: Type of Feedback
content: Select the category that best describes your issue — Bug, Feature Request, Data Quality Issue, or others. This routes your ticket to the correct team immediately.

title: Subject
content: Write a clear, concise title — for example 'Alert not triggering on Tank B-03'. A specific subject helps support prioritise and locate your ticket faster.

title: Detailed Description
content: Describe what happened, what you expected, and include any relevant tank or shipment IDs. The more detail you provide, the faster the support team can reproduce and resolve the issue.

title: Priority
content: Set the urgency — Low, Medium, High, or Critical. Reserve Critical for issues actively impacting patient safety or live operations.

title: Affected Modules
content: Select every part of the platform your issue affects. This tells the engineering team exactly which area of the system to investigate.

title: Agreement & Submit
content: Check the agreement box to confirm you consent to being contacted about your ticket. The Submit button stays disabled until this box is ticked.

title: Submit Feedback
content: Click Submit Feedback to send your ticket to the myGrape support team. You'll land on a confirmation page showing your ticket ID — keep it for any follow-up.

title: Ticket Submitted!
content: Your support ticket has been submitted. The myGrape team will review it and respond to your registered email within 24 hours.

title: Your Ticket ID
content: Save this ticket ID — it appears in your Support Activity list and is your reference number for any follow-up with the support team.

title: Back to Profile
content: Click Go to Profile to return to your profile page, where the ticket you just submitted will appear in your Support Activity list.

title: Your Tickets
content: Your submitted ticket now appears here. All tickets are listed — showing Ticket ID, title, type, and current status.

title: Ticket ID
content: Each ticket gets a unique ID like TK-2026-04-001 on creation. Use this ID when following up with support so they can pull up your request instantly.

title: Ticket Status
content: Tickets move through three stages: Open → In Review → Resolved. Track progress here without needing to contact support separately.

title: Ticket Type
content: Each ticket is categorised by type — Bug Report, Feature Request, or General Query — so the right team picks it up immediately.

title: View Ticket Details
content: Click any row to open the full ticket — read the complete description, view support team comments, and add your own follow-up notes.
